name: Apollo
shortInfo: Find and research leads, personalize messaging, and launch campaigns
brief: Apollo.io is primarily used for **outbound prospecting, lead generation, and sales engagement**. It enables teams to find verified emails, send automated sequences, and manage sales workflows in one platform.
about: The Apollo Reverse ETL connector enables streaming data from a user determined warehouse (checkout model configuration [here](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/data_models.html)) to the Apollo platform in an automated manner.
availableSync:
[Accounts](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/apollo/syncs/accounts.html)

This sync can be used to upload accounts from a user specified data warehouse to the Apollo platform.

[Contacts](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/apollo/syncs/contacts.html)

This sync can be used to upload contacts from a user specified data warehouse to the Apollo platform.

[Deals](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/apollo/syncs/deals.html)

This sync can be used to upload deals from a user specified data warehouse to the Apollo platform.
